Card Q&A.a: No, it can't. If you have a Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name at the timing when this effect activates, your opponent's Digimon that was affected by the "doesn't unsuspend" effect doesn't unsuspend even if your Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name is later removed from the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card when I had a Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name. If my Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name is removed from the battle area by an effect after activating this card, can my opponent's Digimon that was affected by the "doesn't unsuspend" effect now unsuspend?

Effect: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if you have a Tamer with [Mimi Tachikawa] in its name, 1 of your opponent's Digimon doesn't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Activate this card's [Main] effect. Then, add this card to the hand.
